# Al Ikhsan Faiq

> Al Ikhsan Faiq (Faiq) is a design engineer from Palembang, Indonesia, specializing in human-centered UI/UX and AI-native design engineering. Faiq works across the whole product: user research and prototypes in Figma, production frontends in React and TypeScript, and AI features built in from the start. Information Systems graduate (GPA 3.96, Cum Laude) from Universitas Sriwijaya.

Portfolio: __SITE_URL__
Open to full-time roles, freelance projects and collaborations in UI/UX design, frontend development and AI-powered products.

## Focus areas

- Human-centered UI/UX: user interviews, information architecture, wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes, design systems, Maze usability testing, SUS analytics
- Frontend engineering: TypeScript, React 19, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Firebase, Express.js, CodeIgniter 3 / PHP, SQL, print CSS
- AI-native design engineering: Google Gemini API, Claude API, OpenAI GPT, teacher-in-the-loop AI, v0, Cursor, Google Stitch, Antigravity AI

## Experience

- Frontend Developer, RS UMMI Electronic Medical Record System (Aug 2026 to present): designed and built enterprise EMR clinical forms in CodeIgniter 3 and Bootstrap, including a custom print layout engine.
- Property Manager & Designer, Kos Nyaman (Sep 2024 to present): built and deployed a responsive property rental platform in React (https://kos-nyaman.vercel.app/); developing an occupancy dashboard with Firebase and an LLM support chatbot.
- Community Service Lead, Website Design Training, LPPM Universitas Sriwijaya (Aug to Oct 2025): taught 20+ teachers to build educational web interfaces with AI-assisted UI tools.
- Lab Assistant, Computer Networking Lab, Universitas Sriwijaya (Aug 2024 to Mar 2025).
- UI/UX Designer Intern, PT Bukit Asam Tbk (Jun to Jul 2024): designed end-to-end Figma interfaces for the CISEA sub-application and the APLB LB3 waste management system.

## Selected projects

- Clairo: AI-native learning management platform for Kurikulum Merdeka with teacher approval gates, 14 Gemini AI functions and an interactive video studio (React 19, Firebase).
- Yappy: AI-native language learning app with conversational scenarios and voice interfaces; 3rd place, National UI/UX Design Competition, SI FEST 2024.
- Neurofit: workout logging app with progressive overload tracking and muscle analytics, validated with Maze.
- PrimaPlus: digital health consultation app with medical directories and patient records.
- FitMart: combined e-commerce and workout tracking app.
- Travelin: flight and lodging booking app with a simple reschedule and refund flow (GDGoC challenge).
- UNSRI GO: campus app for Universitas Sriwijaya students (course registration, shuttle tracking, exam schedules).
